nodes.title: EPS Frame Saver - pick your own video
Note
widgets_values:
# TEST: EPS Frame Saver - pull one exact frame out of a video

**Point it at a video first.** That is the only setup, and any video already
on the machine running ComfyUI will do. Nothing else: no checkpoint, no
lora, no GPU.

The path ships **empty** on purpose. A path off my machine would be useless
on yours - and this node never copies your video into ComfyUI's `input`
folder anyway. It reads the file where it lies and leaves it there.

## Pass 1 - point it somewhere

Click **Browse...** and pick a video.

(Browse only works when your browser and ComfyUI are on the same machine. If
you are driving ComfyUI over the network, click into the path field and
paste a path the *server* can see instead - it is the server that opens the
file, not your browser.)

Press **Run**. The Preview Image node shows frame 0.

## Pass 2 - scrub to the moment you want

Use the transport strip under the preview: jump to start, back 5, back 1,
play/pause, forward 1, forward 5. Hold a step button down to run through
frames. The counter reads `Frame X / N`, so you always know where you are
and how long the video is. Or type the frame number straight into the box.

Press Run at any frame and that exact frame comes out.

## The thing to trust

The preview on the node is **an approximation** - fast, and good enough to
find the moment. The frame that comes *out* of the node is decoded fresh
from the file on every run, so what you save is what is really in the video,
not what you were looking at while scrubbing. If the two ever disagree, the
output is the right one.

## Try this

- Wire the `width` and `height` outputs somewhere. The node reports the
  video's real frame size, so you never have to go and look it up.
- Leave the path empty and press Run. You get a plain sentence telling you
  the path is empty, not a wall of red.
- Feed the `image` output into **EPS Resolution** to normalise the frame
  before img2img - video frames are rarely a size a sampler likes.
- Point two Frame Savers at the same video on different frames and feed both
  into an **EPS Switcher** to flip between them without rewiring.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## What you get

One frame, as a picture, the moment you press Run.

The video itself never moves and never gets copied. If you delete the video
later, this workflow stops working - it is a pointer, not a copy.

Swap Preview Image for a Save Image if you want the frame on disk.
